verdict.rationale: The pack documents no ZCode feature for setting retention periods or deleting stored or uploaded data. `ZCODE_DATA_BASE_DIR` only chooses where local data is written, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit. The note that a new install won't delete existing session data is not a user-facing deletion capability, and the community reports about cloud uploads describe data collection rather than any retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
